projects.title: Weather App
projects.description: A simple 🌐 Real-Time Weather App that displays current weather conditions for any city worldwide using the OpenWeatherMap API 🔥.
projects.longDescription: A simple weather app that displays real-time weather conditions of cities worldwide using the OpenWeatherMap API. Users can search for any city and view current weather details like temperature, humidity, wind speed, and weather status.
features: Dynamic UI changes based on weather

projects.title: E-commerce Platform
projects.description: A full-featured e-commerce platform with product listings, cart functionality, and secure checkout.
projects.longDescription: This comprehensive e-commerce solution includes product catalog management, user authentication, shopping cart functionality, and secure payment processing. Built with python django , it provides a seamless shopping experience with features like product search, filters, user reviews, and order tracking.
features: Product catalog with search and filters

projects.title: Momo Ordering App
projects.description: A simple and elegant food ordering app for momos with user authentication using Django.
projects.longDescription: The Momo Ordering App is a minimal and user-friendly web application that allows users to browse, select, and order different varieties of momos. Built with Django, it integrates basic authentication (signup, login, logout) ensuring secure access to user-specific features like order history. The app emphasizes clean UI, smooth navigation, and fast performance to enhance the user experience.
features: Clean and responsive UI for easy ordering
Momo categories and item detail view
Simple admin interface to manage orders

projects.title: Email Spam Detection System
projects.description: Real-time spam classifier using Naïve Bayes and Streamlit for instant email filtering.
projects.longDescription: This machine learning-based Email Spam Detection System uses a Naïve Bayes algorithm to classify email messages as spam or non-spam. With an intuitive and interactive Streamlit UI, users can paste or type email content to instantly receive a prediction. The model is trained with NLP techniques to effectively analyze and filter unwanted messages. Designed for speed, simplicity, and real-time interaction, the system is ideal for quick demonstrations and practical use cases in spam filtering.
features: Naïve Bayes classification for spam detection
Real-time email prediction with Streamlit UI

projects.title: Sports Person Image Classifier
projects.description: A machine learning web app to classify images of sports celebrities using face detection and SVM.
projects.longDescription: The Sports Person Image Classifier is a Flask-based machine learning web application that classifies uploaded images into sports celebrities like Virat Kohli, Lionel Messi, Cristiano Ronaldo, Chris Gayle, and Ricky Ponting. The system detects faces using Haar cascades, extracts features using wavelet transforms, and classifies them using a tuned SVM model. With a drag-and-drop UI and clear result display, the app provides a practical and engaging ML demo for image classification use cases.
features: Face and eye detection with Haar cascades
Reference image display and prediction output
Error handling for missing faces or bad input
